# Security Policy

Thank you for helping keep Persian Music Scales secure.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** disclose suspected security vulnerabilities in a public GitHub issue, discussion, or pull request.

Use the repository's **Report a vulnerability** option to submit a private report:

https://github.com/PersianMusicScales/Persian-Music-Scales-App/security/advisories/new

Include the affected page or component, steps to reproduce, the potential impact, and any relevant technical evidence. Do not include passwords, API tokens, private user information, or recordings from other people.

## Scope

Security reports relevant to the current published Persian Music Scales website, its Progressive Web App, microphone and audio-processing features, and repository dependencies are welcome.

Vulnerabilities in externally hosted services should also be reported to the appropriate service provider.

## Response and disclosure

Reports will be reviewed as resources permit. No guaranteed response or remediation deadline is offered.

Please coordinate public disclosure with the repository maintainer after the issue has been assessed and, where applicable, a fix is available.

## Intellectual property

This policy establishes a reporting channel only. It does not grant permission to reuse, redistribute, or commercially exploit proprietary application code. See [LICENSE](../LICENSE) and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for applicable terms.
